picks.why: The update provides a faster iteration cycle for native video generation, allowing users to test 15-second clips without changing cost structures or context limits.

picks.why: New routing tools automate model selection to manage costs and performance, while Tencent's Hy4 provides a new option for complex, long-horizon agentic workflows.

Tencent released Hy4, which offers improved agentic capabilities and performance for long-horizon tasks with a 1,048,576 token context window.

picks.why: This vulnerability allows attackers to bypass critical hardware-level security, making immediate patching essential to maintain system integrity on your Apple devices.

picks.why: 政府高層對黃之鋒案定性及研議上訴，顯示當局對國安案件的執法立場持續強硬，相關法律風險與判刑標準對社會影響深遠。

picks.why: 地盤安全監管趨嚴，承建商若未落實車輛與人員分隔措施，將面臨停工及刑事責任，相關職安警示將透過職安健2.0應用程式發布。

勞工處正調查事故責任，並提醒僱主須架設屏障分隔工人與車輛，違反職安健條例最高可判罰款一千萬元及監禁兩年。
